name: Nanairo Kouro
source:
Sakuta is quite hard done by at the moment - his parents have left the country so he is currently homeless. One day, he is walking down the street when he feels something wet fall onto him, looking up, a young girl named Enishi falls onto him too. Enishi claims to be an apprentice goddess of marriage and tells Sakuta that what fell onto him was actually "God's Pheromone" which means that every girl he meets will fall in love with him and that this pheromone cannot be collected until he falls in love too.

Just after this, Sakuta saves a rich girl called Mirai from some thugs and she falls in love with him (due to the peheromone's power). Then she decides to let Sakuta transfer to her school as a reward.However this is no normal school, Mirai attends the Princess Mary - a high-class school on a cruise liner!

Now his new life starts, what will happen to him now?
translation:
朔太目前處境十分艱難——父母離開了這個國家，他也無家可歸。一天走在街上時，他感覺有某種溼漉漉的東西落到身上；抬頭一看，名叫緣的年輕女孩也掉了下來。緣自稱見習姻緣女神，告訴朔太，剛才落在他身上的其實是「神之費洛蒙」。這意味著他遇見的每個女孩都會愛上他，而且在他自己墜入愛河之前，費洛蒙都無法回收。

緊接著，朔太從流氓手中救下一名叫未來的富家女孩。她受到費洛蒙影響，愛上了他，並決定讓朔太轉進她的學校來報答他。然而這並非普通學校，未來就讀的Princess Mary是一所設在郵輪上的貴族學校！

他的新生活就此開始，接下來會發生什麼？
